name: dfn-3dec
description: Select contacts and subcontacts created by the discrete fracture network named s; several names may follow and are OR-ed. The manual also lists faces, but on 3DEC 9.8.54 the element does not filter faces or zones (every face and zone passes); use fracture-id for face-level selection.
notes: Live 3DEC 9.8.54 (two deterministic fractures cut with 'block cut dfn', 4 blocks, 6 contacts, 80 faces, 47 zones): dfn-3dec 'd1' selected the 2 face-face contacts of fracture 1 and their subcontacts; 'd2' the 2 face-face contacts of fracture 2 plus the 2 edge-edge contacts on the intersection line (those went to the second cut); 'd1' 'd2' all 6. 'block face group ... range dfn-3dec' tagged 80/80 faces and 'block zone group ...' 47/47 zones, outer faces included, so the manual's 'selects faces' does not hold there.
